message: Last week, a sudden power outage caught me off guard while I was enjoying a movie night. Thankfully, I had charged up my power bank earlier, so my phone stayed alive for some music and a few games to keep spirits high. I even dug out my trusty lantern, turning the living room into a cozy, makeshift camping spot. It was a small win that turned a potentially dreary evening into a fun adventure. Have you had a similar experience that turned into a bright moment?
